notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating a token copy of Godo with haste.
Put the nontoken Godo into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Godo enters the battlefield, causing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Declare the token Godo as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block and kill it.
Godo triggers, untapping it and all Samurai you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
